title: Jessica's Banana Pudding
description: A classic layered banana pudding with vanilla wafers, fresh bananas, and warm vanilla pudding.

steps.instruction: In a casserole dish, layer vanilla wafers and banana slices, alternating layers.
Prepare the vanilla pudding according to package directions using the milk.
Pour the hot pudding over the layered wafers and bananas.
Let sit at room temperature until the pudding begins to set and wafers soften.
